component.notes:
Savant OpenWx: weather, forecast and NWS watches/warnings from the OpenWx bridge service. Manual: MANUAL.pdf in the release package. Values update every 5 minutes; only changed values are sent.
SETUP 1. Set the Host (IP) Address to the machine running the bridge (usually this Savant host's own IP). Port 2350. 2. Open the profile in Inspector, select "State Variables": - "Site Coordinates": the job site as lat,lon (e.g. 29.7604,-95.3698). - "Location Override" (optional): a zip (77494), lat,lon, or City, ST. Takes priority over Site Coordinates. Leave blank to use Site Coordinates. Both are sent to the bridge automatically when the host starts. 3. To change the override at runtime: update "Location Override", then run the SendLocationOverride action. 4. "Contact Email": your company email. NWS, EPA, MET Norway and USNO ask for contact info with every request. SYS_CONTACT_SET = 1 once a real address is set (here or in the bridge's config.json). 5. Optional "Open-Meteo API Key": with a key the forecast comes from Open-Meteo's commercial service; the word private uses Open-Meteo's free service (personal/office testing only, not client installs); blank uses the free National Weather Service forecast + EPA UV (US only). SYS_FORECAST_SOURCE shows which. 6. Optional thresholds for the ACT_ flags: the "Threshold ..." state variables (blank = the bridge's config.json value). Sent at startup; after changing one at runtime, run the SendThresholds action. TH_* states show the thresholds the bridge is actually using.
Location priority on the bridge: Location Override, then Site Coordinates, then default_location in its config.json. All weather states are listed in STATES.md. Gate weather automations on SYS_ONLINE = 1.

state_variable.name: Location Override
state_variable.note: Optional: zip, lat,lon, or City, ST. Blank = use Site Coordinates

state_variable.name: Contact Email
state_variable.note: Your company email, sent to NWS/EPA/MET Norway/USNO as their terms ask. Blank = contact_email in the bridge's config.json

state_variable.name: Open-Meteo API Key
state_variable.note: Optional. Your key: Open-Meteo commercial forecast. private: free Open-Meteo for personal/office testing only (non-commercial). Blank: free NWS forecast + EPA UV (US only)

state_variable.name: Threshold Wind Protect Gust
state_variable.note: mph; ACT_WIND_PROTECT = 1 when gust now or in the next 3 h reaches this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 25)

state_variable.name: Threshold Rain Soon Chance
state_variable.note: %; ACT_RAIN_SOON = 1 when rain chance in the next 3 h reaches this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 50)

state_variable.name: Threshold Rain Expected Chance
state_variable.note: %; H3/H12/H24_RAIN_EXPECTED = 1 at or above this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 40)

state_variable.name: Threshold Freeze Temp
state_variable.note: degrees F; ACT_FREEZE_TONIGHT / *_FREEZE_EXPECTED at or below this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 32)

state_variable.name: Threshold High UV
state_variable.note: UV index; ACT_HIGH_UV = 1 at or above this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 8)

state_variable.name: Threshold Heat Feels Like
state_variable.note: degrees F; ACT_HEAT = 1 when feels-like reaches this. Blank = bridge config.json (default 100)
